title: Palazzo Farnese

buildingCutout.basis: Exact current Protomaps OSM relation 22289 building perimeter. The coverage threshold protects the separately mapped neighboring buildings.

note: Rome’s three-storey Renaissance palace with thirteen piazza-facing bays, an arched portal and balcony, alternating piano-nobile pediments, a projecting travertine cornice, an open arcaded court, and the Via Giulia garden loggia. A 32 m absolute datum and the original Terrarium field seat the model. The piazza portal starts at 33.7 m. The exposed garden-side base starts lower to follow the original grade. Foundations extend into native terrain and the court stays open.
